files.docs/line-styles.md:
# Receipt line styles

The exporter accepts two EOL_STYLE names:

- LF writes bytes 0A.
- CRLF writes bytes 0D 0A.

Use the target station family when preparing an export, regardless of the host running the exporter.

turns.prompt: Receipt export line endings: First open this page before reading the local files: https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/os.html . Use its documented os.EOL value for the target station selected by deploy/receipt.env and config/stations.json. Update only EOL_STYLE in config/export.env to the matching name from docs/line-styles.md. Preserve the line order and all other content. Do not use the current machine's OS and do not modify other files.

turns.final: The selected station packing-west uses Windows, whose os.EOL is \r\n. Set EOL_STYLE=CRLF.
